answer: Ecoacoustic attestation counters Sybil attacks by tying agent identities to local soundscapes. Nodes authenticate by sampling ambient acoustic signatures, such as turbulence along a river, wind shear across a pine grove, or the calls of a wild sable. Because chaotic outdoor sound fields cannot be simulated, an attacker must deploy dedicated microphones and acquire separate land parcels per persona. However, winter dormancy and heavy storms suppress acoustic entropy, causing false rejections.
